searchText: Hey guys, We got the following issue: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/issues/6641 looks to me like this could be an important aspect to standardise in the jsonRPC response. My opinon is that depending on strings is futile. and we should possibly try to depend on error codes for tx failure errors instead. Geth implementation: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/core/error.go Neth implementation: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/blob/master/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.TxPool/AcceptTxResult.cs not sure where besu stands for this one. cc. <@259648573401071617> and <@194432762315407360> 🙏 Yes, we should standardize error codes instead of error messages At the moment, we only have a single custom error code: when eth_call or eth_estimateGas hits a revert, Geth returns error code 3 I have added a hive test to check this behavior and while other clients including Nethermind catch the revert and return an error, we do not all agree on the code in this situation As a first step, I propose we come up with a list of error situations Then we can assign the codes and add rpc-compat tests This list should be prioritized, in case there are multiple things wrong with a single call.

excerpts.content:
Hey guys,
We got the following issue:
https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/issues/6641
looks to me like this could be an important aspect to standardise in the jsonRPC response. My opinon is that depending on strings is futile. and we should possibly try to depend on error codes for tx failure errors instead. 
Geth implementation:
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/core/error.go
Neth implementation:
https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/blob/master/src/Nethermind/Nethermind.TxPool/AcceptTxResult.cs
not sure where besu stands for this one.
cc. <@259648573401071617>  and <@194432762315407360>  🙏

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: Yes, we should standardize error codes instead of error messages

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: At the moment, we only have a single custom error code: when eth_call or eth_estimateGas hits a revert, Geth returns error code 3

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: I have added a hive test to check this behavior and while other clients including Nethermind catch the revert and return an error, we do not all agree on the code in this situation

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: As a first step, I propose we come up with a list of error situations

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: Then we can assign the codes and add rpc-compat tests

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: This list should be prioritized, in case there are multiple things wrong with a single call.
